name: Card Data Reading 1 Code
definition: Type of reading of the card data.

PHYS.name: Physical
PHYS.definition: Keyboard entry or OCR reading of embossing or printed data, either at time of transaction or after the event.

CICC.name: ICC
CICC.definition: ICC (Integrated Circuit Card) with contact containing software applications conform to ISO 7816.

ECTL.name: EMV Proximity Reader
ECTL.definition: Contactless proximity reader, with application conform to the standard EMV (standard initiated by Europay, Mastercard and Visa).
